Game Overview

In Crazy Lemmings 2, the core idea is straightforward: guide the frantic lemmings to safety by skillfully maneuvering your craft to catch them before they plunge into the depths. Test your reflexes in a whimsical and intense rescue mission, where every second counts and each saved lemming brings a joyful cheer!
